index: California Consumer Price Index for all items, June to June (Dept. of Industrial Relations), applied to the prior year's brackets
base_year: chained: each year's brackets = prior year's brackets x factor, from 1988
quote: (h) For each taxable year beginning on or after January 1, 1988, the Franchise Tax Board shall recompute the income tax brackets prescribed in subdivisions (a) and (c). ... (1) The California Department of Industrial Relations shall transmit annually to the Franchise Tax Board the percentage change in the California Consumer Price Index for all items from June of the prior calendar year to June of the current calendar year ... (A) Compute an inflation adjustment factor by adding 100 percent to the percentage change figure ... and dividing the result by 100. (B) Multiply the preceding taxable year income tax brackets by the inflation adjustment factor ... and round off the resulting products to the nearest one dollar ($1).
